title: Nutritional facts
lead: BOTIA does not score the food. It shows what the label declares and, only when methodologically valid, places that value next to an applicable official reference.
declared_empty: No nutritional values were supplied to this view.
references_title: Official references applicable to these values
references_note: A comparison appears only when the definition, basis and reference are compatible.
references_empty: No applicable official comparison has been supplied.
method_note: Declared value and official reference are kept visually separate. If the comparison is not methodologically valid, BOTIA does not invent a percentage or a bar.
disclaimer: Nutrition Facts contextualizes declared data. It does not classify the food as healthy or unhealthy.
